in_sanskrit.name: Ku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ku is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds great significance in Hindu mythology. It is a unisex name and is considered a form of Lord Shiva. Ku is believed to represent the creative and destructive aspects of the universe, symbolizing transformation and regeneration. In Hindu scriptures, it is mentioned that Lord Shiva is often referred to as 'Kuvera', the god of wealth, and 'Kubera', the king of Alaka-puri, the land of gods. The name Ku is also believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
